content: Lol half this board still doesn't get it. I was in the room with people who actually ship. Not explaining again.
Stack tour (again): three frameworks, two clouds, 'advisor' on a thing you haven't heard of. DM for collab if you're serious — serious people know what that means.
Asking for logs is junior energy. When you've scaled what I've scaled you stop asking basic questions.
Who's coming to the mixer? I can intro you to the right circle. Bring a deck. Leave the ticket nitpicks at home.
Cute postmortem. Real operators don't write essays for free on forums. Some of us were on calls you weren't invited to.
If my tone bothers you, that's a you problem. High performers are intense. Adapt or stay average.
